name: soft-cozy-bedroom-aesthetic-reflection
image_purpose: aesthetic reflection composition and bedroom atmosphere reference

prompt.project_info: Create a soft aesthetic bedroom mirror-reflection photograph using the supplied local image as the required composition reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult person seated on a bed with legs and feet comfortably extended toward an ornate white mirror, holding a smartphone; face may remain obscured by the phone and focus stays on the reflection composition.
prompt.composition_elements: Low smartphone angle from the feet, sharp relaxed feet and foreground legs, softer mirror reflection of the seated person, pastel bedding, ornate white mirror frame, and no creator signature or watermark.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm diffused ambient bedroom light with a subtle lavender-purple glow, calm dreamy cozy mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone photography, square 1:1 composition, sharp foreground with gentle background falloff, natural skin texture, soft gradients.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Soft dreamy bedroom mirror-reflection photograph with an approved adult person seated on pastel bedding, feet and legs comfortably extended toward an ornate white mirror while holding a phone. Use warm diffused light, subtle lavender glow, pastel pink and beige palette, realistic skin texture, sharp foreground feet, and a softly blurred reflection. No creator signature or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized framing, nudity, lingerie, voyeuristic emphasis, distorted feet, extra toes, malformed legs, warped mirror, blur on foreground, creator signature, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

assets.name: soft-cozy-bedroom-aesthetic-reflection_0.jpg

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Preserve composition, mirror, bedding, palette, lighting, and foreground/background focus; replaceability applies to the approved adult subject only when a new reference is attached. Remove the supplied creator signature and keep typography absent.

changes: Removed creator signature reproduction and reinforced non-voyeuristic, non-sexualized framing.
